page.layout: One printed page: running head "INDEX" with "X." at the top; two parallel columns of index entries below, left column then right column; a final catchword-like line "Lega" at lower right of the right column.

main_text.l: Isai filius Dauid per cō temptū appellatus 23

page.notes: Scan is a faded print; several Greek and abbreviated words in entries (e.g. "Laboratesque cibados", "Lamechus impius" with Greek numeral/word) are doubtful. Right column entry "Iusiurandum legitimum" is split across columns; the left-column "Iusiurandum legitimum" line and the right-column "quibus ornandum" line were combined as printed order. Greek word after "impius" is illegible.
